{{Top|leg}}
'''Methane-breathers''' were specialized [[Breath mask/Legends|breath masks]]. They allowed [[Morseerian/Legends|Morseerians]] to breath [[Methane/Legends|methane]] while in [[Oxygen/Legends|oxygen]] environments. [[Nabrun Leids/Legends|Nabrun Leids]] made use of a methane-breather.<ref name="SSR">''[[Secrets of the Sisar Run]]''</ref>
